basic_info.description: Discover an exceptional investment opportunity at 28-32 Elgin Park in San Francisco's vibrant Mint Hill neighborhood. This well-maintained multi-family property, built in 1908, comprises four turnkey units, each thoughtfully updated in recent years to blend historic charm with modern conveniences.  Unit Configuration: The front building features three full-floor flats, each offering 2 bedrooms, while a charming, free-standing rear cottage provides additional living space.  Modern Updates: All units have been recently renovated, ensuring a move-in-ready experience for tenants and maximizing rental potential.  Spacious Layout: Collectively, the property boasts a generous 3,392 square feet of living space, providing comfortable accommodations across all units.  Prime Location: Situated near the Valencia Corridor, Hayes Valley, and Market Street, residents enjoy easy access to a plethora of shopping, dining, and transportation options.  Historic Appeal: Period details such as high ceilings and classic architectural elements have been preserved, adding to the property's unique character.  The property presents a compelling opportunity for investors seeking a stable income stream and is poised to attract discerning tenants and provide long-term value.
